purpose: Repeat phase-1 completion-only benchmark with Qwen 3.8 27B and local Laya threshold 0.8
primary_split: original holdout reused validation; not unseen confirmation
order: Three concurrent domain processes, each with four case groups; each case has sequential paired arms with alternating first arm.
pilot: Two development cases per domain; compatibility check only, not tuning
coverage_policy: Context rejection/abstention retains original fallback; no prompt compression or relaxed truncation detection
scope: Final output accuracy plus acceptance audit; not whole-SOP compliance guarantee
cost_policy: Report token/call counts. API dollar estimates only with verified Qwen rates; local compute is not free hardware.
driver_note: Reuses phase2-named schedule driver and trace directory, but planning/compilation is explicitly disabled in both arms.
